integrity: Same-model analytic proof reconstruction plus a standalone standard-library checker; finite grid tests corroborate but do not prove universal statements. No independent external scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: An initially empty, one-dimensional, finite-capacity storage element, three ordered fixed positive instantaneous rainfall pulses, constant exponential drainage, and fixed first-to-last time are assumed. The decision variable is only the middle-event time. No empirically controlled storms, stochastic prediction, peak-flow performance, or priority over all general finite-buffer scheduling results is asserted.
title: Convex overflow envelope and exact gap allocation for three rain pulses
